description: Searchable and labellable stars: every star in l0 + l1 carrying an IAU proper name, a Bayer Greek letter or a Flamsteed number. `i` is the global index into the l0 ++ l1 concatenation.

fields.i: global star index into the l0 ++ l1 concatenation
fields.m: apparent magnitude, full precision (not the quantized uint8)
